clock_status.data_as_of: Last complete closed exchange session; do not infer from newest partial row or wall clock.
clock_status.exact_run_time: Not chosen or verified in this design. A proposed after-close schedule is not provider availability proof.
clock_status.input_complete_at: Must be separately attested; collection configuration or partial receipt is insufficient.
clock_status.intended_execution_session: Explicit next eligible session for an end-of-day workflow, not automatically the same calendar date.
clock_status.missed_or_incomplete_input: Report blocked/WAIT; never backdate, force picks or fabricate a lock.
clock_status.provider_published_at: Unverified until a source supplies/establishes it.
clock_status.report_locked_at: After valid inputs and before intended execution/outcome; deadline anchored to reviewed session calendar.
